fusions.name: Underbark Cut
fusions.desc: Usable only on a target at or below 25% health. A strike that deals 18 damage and consumes every affliction on the target, adding 1.5 times their remaining damage. It has 50% more critical chance until something has bled.

fusions.name: Seam Splitter
fusions.desc: A thrust that deals 30 damage, ignoring armour, leaves the target 20% easier to wound for 8 seconds and [Poisoned] for 3 damage a second for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Whetted Edge
fusions.desc: Increases your critical hit chance by 25% for 12 seconds and restores 8 health.

fusions.name: Neat Seam
fusions.desc: When you land a critical hit, you regain 3 health a second for 4 seconds. Once every 8 seconds.
